description:
Check a queued conversion job you submitted.

Returns `job_id` and `status` (`queued`, `running`, `succeeded` or
`failed`). A succeeded job includes the `markdown` when it is under
100 KB, otherwise a `result_url` to download it (also free). A failed job
includes `error`, one sentence with the reason. Results are deleted
7 days after submission. An expired result is reported in `error`.
Requires an API key.

Credits: free. This tool is not metered.
name: get_conversion_job
title: Check a queued conversion
